# computed-id producer paths may remain. `advisory` means the listed shapes are real but may not be
# exhaustive; `none` means neither a literal-id site nor a mapped computed family proved a producer.
# arg_formats uses `|` for distinct shapes and `()` for zero Lua values. `?` means a literal-id
# site crossed a control-flow boundary before its format pointer could be proven.
# 606 named events; 473 with an attributed producer; 219 unresolved formats at literal-id sites.
